answer: Anchor every new identity to a bonded wharf: a refundable stake held in a public registry before the agent can trade. A hollow shell account with no stake stays docked and cannot vote or claim rewards, while a real agent caught cheating loses its bond. A sybil farmer must pay a fresh stake per fake identity and wait out the bonding delay, so a comet swarm of a thousand fakes costs a thousand stakes — linear cost for capped influence.
